email.subject: Mainline Works: two quick fixes for Harbor Falls calls
email.body:
Hi Sofia,

I looked at Mainline Works' site. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call number, so mobile visitors searching "plumber Harbor Falls" can't tap to dial and probably just call the next result. And there are no reviews shown, which matters a lot for plumbing since people want proof before letting someone into their home.

The page is also slow from heavy images and the title tag is weak for search, but those two above are the ones actually losing you jobs.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I'd fix.

Alex
Northlight Web
